verdict.rationale: Subscription-lifecycle features such as trials and coupons are a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions free trials, coupons, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications. The only notification evidence covers generic invoice emails and overdue or failed-payment reminders, which are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
